title: Mirabel and the Wolf
author: Elodie Voss
blurb: Lior Blackwood, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
